title: District Commission may direct parties to consider mediation
description: Who: District Commission. What: may direct parties to give in writing consent to have their dispute settled by mediation. Conditions: at the first hearing of the complaint after its admission, or at any later stage; if it appears that there exists elements of a settlement which may be acceptable to the parties; except in such cases as may be prescribed. Limitations: within five days
